fonts.body: Inter (for standard legibility in forms and dense text)
fonts.data_and_ids: IBM Plex Mono (for Auftragsnummer, QR Codes, and Inventory SKUs)

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl md:text-5xl tracking-tighter uppercase font-bold text-white

anti_patterns: Do NOT use Inter for headings.

rules: Strictly dark theme base. No soft gray gradients.
Primary actions (e.g., 'Auftrag erstellen') use high-contrast White/Black.
SLA Alerts (3-Day SLA) use stark Red (#EF4444) with neon/pulsing 1px borders.
Teal Green / Teal Blue (#1B93A4) is STRICTLY FORBIDDEN.
Tint all neutral grays slightly cool to avoid 'dead' grays.

implementation: Use strict rectangular structures. Avoid excessive border-radius (`rounded-sm` max).
Dashboard containers should use `border-collapse` style layouts.
Items inside grids get `border-r border-b border-border/40`.
Use Glassmorphism (bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10) ONLY for sticky navs and dialogs. NO purely transparent backgrounds over content.
shadows: Avoid soft shadows. Rely on 1px solid strokes or 2px 'Inner Glow' highlights to separate layers.

grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: Use generous internal padding. p-6 or p-8 inside bordered containers.
grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 or gap-6
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Left-align dense text and tables. Only center metrics if isolated in a square widget.

specifics.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Labels must be uppercase mono.
specifics.tables: Dense, full-width data tables for Inventory (Ersatzteile) and Orders (Aufträge). Use sticky headers.
specifics.buttons: Sharp corners (`rounded-none` or `rounded-sm`). High contrast hover states.
specifics.badges: For status (z.B., 'In Bearbeitung', 'Abgeschlossen'). Flat bg with bright text.
specifics.receipt_print: Create a specific `@media print` layout or a clean minimalist component for the 80mm thermal 'Abholschein'. Must be monochrome, sans-serif, high legibility.
specifics.chat: Real-time chat widget embedded inside the Order Details panel. Differentiate Techniker vs Mitarbeiter bubbles clearly.

rules: Hover states on table rows: `hover:bg-zinc-900 transition-colors duration-150`.
Do NOT use universal `transition: all`. Use specific `transition-colors` or `transition-transform`.
SLA Alerts: Use `animate-pulse` or a CSS keyframe border-glow for tickets older than 3 days.
All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="btn-create-order"`).
Hover states must explicitly set text color (e.g., `hover:bg-white hover:text-black`).
Contrast ratio for text must be at least 4.5:1.

images.strategy: Minimal. ERP systems rely on data, not photography.

assets.description: Subtle gray concrete monolith representing Berlin industrial tech.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The entire UI MUST be in German (z.B. Auftrag, Techniker, Mitarbeiter, Abholschein, Ersatzteile, Filialen).
CRITICAL: Implement Role-based routing/views. Admin sees everything. Mitarbeiter sees front-desk tools. Techniker sees assigned tasks WITHOUT customer PII (DSGVO compliance).
Use Phosphor Icons for all technical pictograms (`yarn add @phosphor-icons/react`).
Replace Shadcn's default variables in index.css with a stark black/white/zinc palette.
Do NOT center align the app container. No `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Implement an 80mm thermal receipt view ('Abholschein') that is printable.
Embed a chat section inside the Order detail view.
Ensure all buttons, inputs, and list items have `data-testid`.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, NOT drop shadows.
Use glass-morphism effects (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/80) ONLY for sticky/floating overlays. NO purely transparent backgrounds over content.
NEVER use universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always specify properties.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui. Customize Shadcn primitives (like changing border radii to be sharper).
